name: rugsnare
description: Runtime integrity for AI agents: report which MCP servers are pinned and approved in this project, and what contract changes the public RugSnare drift-feed has detected across popular MCP servers. Read-only, zero dependencies, no telemetry.

tools.name: drift_feed_status
tools.description: Report the current versions and contract-change events of popular MCP servers, from the public RugSnare drift-feed (daily scans). Optional filter by server name.

tools.name: pins_report
tools.description: Report the RugSnare pin store of this project: which MCP servers are pinned, how many tools are approved, unapproved, or shadowed across servers. Read-only.
